reviews.comment: Round 1 AI review: APPROVED. Strip-and-extend lands cleanly: 13/13 tests pass, no forbidden tech in canonical text, PR_API.md technology-agnostic, prompt-build.ts simplified. 6 non-blocking notes (prStrategy dropped without doc, --examples flag deferred, README pointer deferred, init.test.mjs vacuous assertion, marker-window heuristic, ~/.github-token shell exposure). N15's three blockers resolved by deletion as planned.

Round 2 human review: 1 blocker. Co-Authored-By trailer in task-git.md hardcodes 'Claude Opus 4.7' — should be generic 'Claude Code' so it's correct regardless of which model (Sonnet/Haiku/future) is authoring. Same delegation pattern as N16's other generalisation fixes. Also: extend no-technology-tight regression test to cover model-name strings.

Round 3 human review: additional blocker on top of Round 2. Bare compare URL fallback should compose a rich pre-fill URL (title + body as query params, URL-encoded) so the create-PR form opens populated. GitHub uses ?expand=1&title=&body=; GitLab uses merge_request[title]/[description]; Bitbucket has limited prefill. Canonical instruction stays host-agnostic; per-host syntax in Examples appendix + PR_API.md.

Round 4 human: appendix no-CLI example at task-git.md:128 also bare URL — escalates Round-3 non-blocking #1 to blocker. Plus: PR_API.md no-CLI example only covers review-fallback, missing PR-create fallback. 3 blockers now stacked (R2 trailer + R3 canonical URL + R4 appendix URL); fold into one fix commit.
